title: [Radio’ Clock] Tea Time Monday with Hwang Bo-seo (황보서)
description:
누구나 할 수 있지만, 이렇게는 못할 것 같은✨️ 🌬 휘파람 챔피언 황보서 님과 함께했습니다🙊

휘파람 세계 대회에서 수상을 하고 휘파람을 알리기 위해서 노력하고 계시다는데요!❤️ 🔥

전혀 못하던 애슐리도,🥹 순식간에 휘파람 소리를 낼 수 있을 정도였죠?!😲

쉽고 빠른 가르침에 휘파람 소리를 자유롭게 낼 수 있게 된 분 또 계신가요~?🫡👋👋

여러분도 쉽게 소리 낼 수 있는 휘파람!😗 도전해 보세요!!🥨

 

Anyone can do it, but not like this✨️ 🌬

We were with pro-whistler Hwang Bo-seo🙊

He won an award at the world whistling competition and is working hard to spread the word about whistling!❤️ 🔥

Even Ashley, who couldn't whistle at all, was able to whistle in an instant!😲

Is there anyone who was able to whistle freely through easy and quick teaching?🫡👋👋

A whistle that you can easily make!😗 Try it!!🥨
